ecosystem_notes.text: Ollama's default context window is 4096 tokens, auto-scaled by available VRAM (4k under 24GB, 32k at 24-48GB, 256k at 48GB+). The widely-copied "2048" figure circulating across AI-written guides is a pre-2026 default and is stale.
ecosystem_notes.editorial_implication: Fast-moving technical DEFAULTS rot exactly like model names — context defaults, driver versions, CLI flags, keep_alive behaviour. Same error class as stale model names; no validator covers it yet (only model NAME staleness is build-gated so far).

ecosystem_notes.text: The NVIDIA Container Toolkit is required only for running Ollama inside Docker with GPU passthrough. A native (non-Docker) install needs only the NVIDIA driver + CUDA runtime; nvidia-smi verifies the driver, not the toolkit.
ecosystem_notes.editorial_implication: Same error class as above — a vendor-tooling scope fact, not a model name, but equally prone to silent copying-forward once wrong.

tier_beginner_4gb.note: Policy requires >=2 vendor/primary sources before this can move to RESOLVED. Populate in the Branch 4 registry-refresh cycle. An empty tier blocks any page from rendering a claim here — do not guess to unblock it.

best_overall_open_weight.note: As of the 2026-07 cycle, current-gen open-weight rankings disagree across sources (candidates seen in the wild: GLM-5.2, MiniMax M3, Qwen 3 235B). Record each source's position here with source_id + retrieved_at rather than picking a winner. An article that resolves this to a single answer without >=2 independent sources in agreement is asserting a consensus that does not exist — this is the exact failure mode that produced the 'Llama 4 Scout (best overall)' error.
